entries.jp: 愛獲の僕が　\nお使いなんて……\n侮辱だよね～
entries.en: Me, an idol,\nrunning errands...\nWhat an insult~

entries.jp: 土方さん　ひどいよ～
entries.en: Hijikata-san,\nyou're so mean~

entries.jp: 現在　テラーダでは\n龍馬帰還と看板娘獲得記念\n宴会が開かれている
entries.en:
At the Terada, a
party was
underway to
celebrate Ryoma's
return and the
new poster girls.

entries.jp:
足りなくなった酒を
買うよう言いつけられた
沖田は　不満を顔に
浮かべて　道を
歩いていた
entries.en:
Ordered to buy
more sake after
it ran out, Okita
walked down
the road with
displeasure
written all over
his face.

entries.jp: まあ　酔っぱらいの中に\nいるより　外の方が\nマシかもね
entries.en:
Well, being out
here probably
beats being
stuck with a
bunch of drunks.

entries.jp: でも　酒屋ってどこさ？\n行き過ぎちゃったかな
entries.en: But where's the\nsake shop? Did\nI walk past it?

entries.jp: ま　いっか　\n夜のお散歩だ\n月が綺麗だしね～
entries.en:
Oh well. A
night stroll it
is. The moon's
pretty, too~

entries.jp: 新選組にいる時には\nこんな事　思ったりも\nしなかったな……
entries.en:
Back in the
Shinsengumi, I'd
never have had a
thought like this...

entries.jp:
月の光に照らされて
沖田は自分の中に
穏やかな気持ちが
満ちていくのを感じる
entries.en:
Bathed in
moonlight,
Okita felt a
calm welling
up inside him.

entries.jp: 月はまるで　近藤の笑顔の\nようだと　沖田は思った
entries.en: The moon, Okita\nthought, was just\nlike Kondo's smile.

entries.jp: ねぇ……近藤さん\n僕は元気にやってるよ\n土方さんも　大丈夫
entries.en:
Hey... Kondo-san.
I'm doing fine.
Hijikata-san's
okay too.

entries.jp: まだ　沈んでいるけど……\nでも　悲しむ暇もないほど
entries.en:
He's still down...
but he doesn't
even have time
to grieve,

entries.jp: トサカくんたちが　色々と\nやらかしてくれるから
entries.en:
since Tosaka-kun
and the others
keep pulling all
kinds of stunts.

entries.jp: だから　心配しないでね\n近藤さん
entries.en: So don't worry\nabout us,\nKondo-san.

entries.jp: 僕はもう迷わないよ\n貴方がくれた命……\n貴方が望んだ夢……
entries.en:
I won't lose my
way anymore.
The life you gave
me... The dream
you wished for...

entries.jp: 近藤さんという月が\n僕の心の夜道を\n照らしてくれるから
entries.en:
You're the moon,
Kondo-san,
lighting the dark
road in my heart.

entries.jp: あの時のように\n間違ったりしないよ
entries.en: I won't make a\nmistake like I\ndid back then.

entries.jp: なにもいらない\n何も欲しくない
entries.en: I need nothing.\nI want nothing.

entries.jp: でも　近藤さんが望むなら\n近藤さんのためなら……
entries.en:
But if Kondo-san
wished it... For
Kondo-san's
sake...

entries.jp: 修羅　外道……\n闇に落ちても\n僕は　構わない……
entries.en:
A demon of
carnage, a fiend...
Even if I fell into
darkness, I
wouldn't care...

entries.jp: そう思うことが　　\nその間違いが
entries.en: Thinking that\nway... That\nmistake...

entries.jp: 近藤さんを\n死なせてしまった……
entries.en: ...is what got\nKondo-san killed...

entries.jp: ――それは\n沖田が龍馬たちと\n出会う前の話……
entries.en:
--This is a tale
from before
Okita met Ryoma
and the others...

entries.jp: 今日も　雷舞を観に\nうじゃうじゃ来てるな～\nよっぽど暇なんだね
entries.en:
They're
swarming in to
see the live again
today~ They must
have way too
much free time.

entries.jp: なんだよ\n今　忙しいんだけど\n……げ
entries.en: What? I'm kind\nof busy right\nnow... ...Ugh.

entries.jp: そういう　お前は\n舞台に出ていて\n忙しいんじゃなかったか？
entries.en:
Look who's
talking. Aren't
you supposed
to be busy out
on stage?

entries.jp: あれ～　どうして\n土方さんが茶屋にいるの？
entries.en:
Huh~? What's
Hijikata-san
doing at a
teahouse?

entries.jp: お前が出番が近くなっても\n戻ってこないからだ\n来いっ
entries.en:
Your turn is
nearly up and
you never came
back. Come on.

entries.jp: 本当に申し訳ありません\n俺の監督不行き届きです
entries.en: I'm truly sorry.\nIt's a failure of\nmy supervision.

entries.jp: いやいや　出番には\n間に合ったんだから\n良しとしよう
entries.en:
Now, now. He
made it in time
for his turn, so
let's call it good.

entries.jp: いいえ　舞台袖で待つのも\n隊士の務めです\nほら　お前も謝れ！
entries.en:
No. Waiting in the
wings is part of a
trooper's duty,
too. Now you
apologize as well!

entries.jp: ……は～い\nごめんなさい
entries.en: ...Okaaay. Sorry.

entries.jp: どうして　舞台袖から\n抜け出したんだ\n総司
entries.en: Why did you\nslip out of the\nwings, Soji?

entries.jp: 珍しい柄の蝶がいたんです\n捕まえて近藤さんに\n見せたくて
entries.en:
There was a
butterfly with a
really rare
pattern. I
wanted to catch
it and show it to
you, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 蝶がいるのは花畑だ\n茶屋の二階に\n蝶などいるか！
entries.en:
Butterflies live
in flower fields!
There are no
butterflies on
the second floor
of a teahouse!

entries.jp: 茶屋の二階に住む蝶か……\nそりゃあ別嬪だっただろう
entries.en:
A butterfly
living on the
second floor of a
teahouse, eh...
She must've been
a real beauty.

entries.jp: 近藤さん　総司の\n言う事を\n信じるんですか？
entries.en: Kondo-san,\nyou believe\nwhat Soji says?

entries.jp: 隊士の言う事を疑う\n局長は居ないだろう
entries.en:
No commander
worth the name
doubts the word
of his troopers.

entries.jp: それに俺でも　そんな\n珍しい蝶なら\n捕まえてみたいと思うさ
entries.en:
Besides, if it
were that rare
a butterfly,
even I'd want to
try catching it.

entries.jp: そうそう　だめだよ～\n純真な少年の好奇心や\n真心を信じられないなんて
entries.en:
Right, right.
Shame on you~
Not believing
in an innocent
boy's curiosity
and sincerity.

entries.jp: このクソガキ……
entries.en: You little brat...

entries.jp: あははっ　次は舞台のこと\n忘れないように\n気をつけま～す
entries.en:
Ahaha. I'll be
careful not to
forget about the
stage next tiiime~

entries.jp: ほら　こう言ってるし\nもう許してあげなさい
entries.en: There, you\nheard him. Go on\nand forgive him.

entries.jp: ……ちっ\n次は無いからな
entries.en: ...Tch. There won't\nbe a next time.

entries.jp: はい　は～い
entries.en: Yes, yeees.

entries.jp: ……あ～あ\n近藤さんも土方さんも\n本当にチョロいな～
entries.en:
...Sheesh~
Kondo-san and
Hijikata-san
are both such
pushovers~

entries.jp:
当時の新選組は
局長の近藤　副長の土方
そして　沖田の三人が
一番人気の隊として
雷舞のトリを務めていた
entries.en:
Then, the top
unit closing every
Shinsengumi live
was Commander
Kondo,
Vice-Commander
Hijikata and
Okita.

entries.jp:
人気実力ともに
新選組随一の三人……
しかし　それを
快く思わない者も居た
entries.en:
The three were
the Shinsengumi's
finest in both
popularity and
skill... but some
did not take
kindly to that.

entries.jp: ……なんで沖田が\n近藤さんや土方さんと\n一緒の組なんだよ
entries.en:
...Why's Okita in
the same unit as
Kondo-san and
Hijikata-san?

entries.jp: 顔がいいからだろ？\n練習もろくに\n出ない癖に
entries.en:
'Cause of his
pretty face,
right? He hardly
ever even shows
up to practice.

entries.jp: 最近　客の入りが\n悪いのだって\nアイツの……
entries.en:
Even the crowds
thinning out
lately is all
because of him...

entries.jp: そういうの人のせいに\nするってよくないな～
entries.en:
Blaming other
people for
stuff like that
isn't very nice~

entries.jp: なっ　沖田！
entries.en: Wha-- Okita!

entries.jp: 僕は近藤さんと土方さんの\nオマケだし　練習も舞台も\n時々しか出ないけど……
entries.en:
Sure, I'm just
Kondo-san and
Hijikata-san's
tagalong, and
I only show up
to practice or
the stage now
and then...

entries.jp: おかしいよね？　一番隊に\n入る前から君たちより\n姿絵の売り上げはいいんだ
entries.en:
Funny, isn't it?
Even before I
joined the
First Unit, my
portrait prints
outsold yours.

entries.jp: それは　煌は\nお前の顔しか\n見てないからだ
entries.en: That's 'cause the\nfans only ever\nlook at your face!

entries.jp: そうだそうだ\n俺たちは毎日　厳しい\n練習に耐えて頑張ってる
entries.en:
Yeah, that's right!
We endure harsh
practice and give
it our all every
single day!

entries.jp: ふ～ん　頑張ってる　ね
entries.en: Hmm~ 'Give it\nour all,' huh.

entries.jp: 一生懸命に練習した結果が\n見た目に負ける程度なら\n……やる必要あるの？
entries.en:
If all that hard
practice still loses
to looks... is there
even any point?

entries.jp: ……くっ
entries.en: ...Ngh.

entries.jp: ほら　その顔……ふふっ\nそういう顔してるから\n煌が逃げるんだよ？
entries.en:
See, that face...
Hehe. Making
faces like that is
why the fans run
away, you know?

entries.jp: 他人の陰口を言う暇が\nあるなら大好きな練習に\n笑顔の練習も加えたら？
entries.en:
If you've got time
to badmouth
people, why not
add smile practice
to all that
practice you love?

entries.jp: バカらしい……\n愛獲なんてなりたくて\nなったわけじゃない
entries.en: How stupid... It's\nnot like I wanted\nto be an idol.

entries.jp: 呑気に人の悪口を言う\n隊士達の馬鹿さ加減に\n沖田はイライラしていた
entries.en:
The troopers'
sheer foolishness,
idly badmouthing
others, got on
Okita's nerves.

entries.jp:
今の新選組の雷舞を
仕切っているのは
自分の利益しか考えない
幕府のお偉方だ
entries.en:
These days the
Shinsengumi's
live shows were
run by shogunate
bigwigs who
thought only of
their own gain.

entries.jp: ……そんな年寄の考えた\n雷舞なんて時代遅れって\nなんで気付かないんだよ
entries.en:
...Why can't
anyone see
that live shows
dreamed up by
old fogeys like
that are behind
the times?

entries.jp: ……なのに近藤さんは\n米つきバッタみたいだよ\n幕府にぺこぺこしてさ
entries.en:
...And still
Kondo-san
keeps bowing
and scraping to
the shogunate
like a bobbing
grasshopper.

entries.jp: 土方さんは土方さんで\n近藤さんの言うこと\n素直に聞いちゃって……
entries.en:
And Hijikata-san
just meekly does
whatever
Kondo-san tells
him...

entries.jp: ……バカじゃない？\n昔はあんなんじゃ\nなかったのに……
entries.en: ...Are they stupid?\nThey didn't used\nto be like this...

entries.jp: 明けない夜が無いように\n止まない雨が無いように\n世の乱れもいつかは収まる
entries.en:
Just as no night
lasts forever
and no rain
falls forever,
the turmoil of
this world will
one day settle.

entries.jp: その時に必要とされるのは\n人を傷つける刀じゃない\n人の心を安らがせる歌だ
entries.en:
What will be
needed then is
not a sword
that wounds
people, but a
song that eases
their hearts.

entries.jp: 歌の力で戦乱を終わらせた\n徳川家康公のように\n私はなりたい
entries.en:
I want to be like
Lord Ieyasu
Tokugawa, who
ended the age
of war with the
power of song.

entries.jp: 歌でこの国を平和にしよう\n付いてきてくれるか？\nトシ　総司
entries.en:
Let's bring peace
to this country
with song. Will
you follow me,
Toshi? Soji?

entries.jp:
そう言って笑う
近藤さんの笑顔のまぶしさに
ひねくれ　ねじくれた心まで
ほぐされていくような
気持ちになった
entries.en:
Kondo-san's smile
as he said it was
so dazzling, I felt
even my warped,
twisted heart
coming loose.

entries.jp: ……って\nそれに　ひょこひょこ\n付いてきて
entries.en: ...And then I\nwent trotting\nalong after him,

entries.jp: ぶーぶー言ってる\n僕が一番バカなのかな～
entries.en:
so maybe I'm
the biggest idiot
of all, griping
like this~

entries.jp: き～めた\n夕方の雷舞はさぼり！
entries.en: Decided~ I'm\nskipping the\nevening live!

entries.jp: 近藤さん\n幕府の使者と名乗る方が\nいらっしゃっています
entries.en:
Kondo-san,
someone claiming
to be a shogunate
envoy is here to
see you.

entries.jp: ……幕府の？\nわかった　すぐに行こう
entries.en:
...From the
shogunate?
Very well, I'll
go at once.

entries.jp: トシは舞台前練習\n（リハーサル）を\n続けていてくれ
entries.en: Toshi, carry\non with the\nrehearsal.

entries.jp: はい
entries.en: Yes, sir.

entries.jp: きゃー\n総司さ～～ん
entries.en: Kyaaa! Soji-san~!

entries.jp: もう　どこに\n行ったのかしら？
entries.en: Oh, where could\nhe have gone?

entries.jp: ……やれやれ\n街中に出てきたのは\n失敗だったかな
entries.en: ...Jeez. Coming\ninto town was a\nmistake, I guess.

entries.jp: 今日は雷舞もあるし\n僕の顔を知ってる人も\n多いだろうしね～
entries.en:
There's a live
today, so lots of
people probably
know my face~

entries.jp: 裏の方を抜けて\n山にでも行こうかな……\nん？
entries.en:
Maybe I'll cut
through the
back streets and
head up the
mountain... Hm?

entries.jp: あれは……近藤さん？\nその隣は……誰？
entries.en:
Isn't that...
Kondo-san? And
next to him...
who's that?

entries.jp:
土方に拾われるまで
盗賊に育てられたことや
愛獲になってからは
大名の娘など　煌からの
贈り物などで
entries.en:
Raised by thieves
until Hijikata took
him in, then
showered with
gifts by fans like
daimyo daughters
once he became
an idol,

entries.jp: 沖田は若いながらも\nかなりの目利きだった
entries.en:
Okita, young
as he was, had
a sharp eye
for quality.

entries.jp:
目立たないようにしては
いるが　その物腰や着物の
生地や仕立ての良さは
離れていてもわかる
entries.en:
The man was
trying not to
stand out, but his
bearing and the
fine cloth and
tailoring of his
kimono showed
even from afar.

entries.jp: 近藤の隣にいる者は\nただの武士ではないと\nわかったのだ
entries.en:
Okita could tell
the man beside
Kondo was no
ordinary samurai.

entries.jp: ……久しいな　近藤
entries.en: ...It has been some\ntime, Kondo.

entries.jp: 井伊様に置かれましても\nつつがなくお過ごしのようで\n大変に……
entries.en:
It gladdens me
to see that you
are in good
health, Ii-sama.
I am truly...

entries.jp: 挨拶はいい
entries.en: Spare me the\npleasantries.

entries.jp: 何故　我がわざわざ\n出向いたのか\nわかるな？
entries.en:
You know why I
have troubled to
come in person,
do you not?

entries.jp: 新しい天歌の話でしたら\nお断りさせて\nいただいたかと
entries.en:
If this is about
the new Heaven's
Song, I believe I
respectfully
declined.

entries.jp: ……ふん\n気は変わらぬか
entries.en: ...Hmph. Your\nmind is\nunchanged, then.

entries.jp: そう言えば最近……\n新選組の雷舞\n客が減っているとか？
entries.en:
Come to think
of it... I hear the
crowds at the
Shinsengumi's
live shows have
been shrinking
of late?

entries.jp: ……それは\n私の不徳の致すところで\nございます
entries.en: ...That is due to\nmy own lack of\nvirtue, my lord.

entries.jp: 誤解をするな　近藤\n責めているわけではない
entries.en:
Do not
misunderstand
me, Kondo. I am
not blaming you.

entries.jp: 都の乱れは目を覆うほどだ\n逃げ出す民も多い……\n上様も嘆いておられる
entries.en:
The disorder in
the capital is too
awful to behold.
Many people are
fleeing... His
Highness
grieves as well.

entries.jp: 民に安寧を促す歌が\n必要だとわかっておろう
entries.en:
Surely you
understand that
the people need
songs that bring
them peace.

entries.jp: なぜ　それを歌おうとは\nしない？
entries.en: Why, then,\nwill you not\nsing them?

entries.jp: 新選組内でも　新しい試み\n新たなる団主に取り組んで\nおります
entries.en:
Within the
Shinsengumi,
too, we are
taking on new
ventures, such
as a new dance.

entries.jp: ならば……\n我の新たな天歌の話も\nそこに加えればよかろう
entries.en:
Then... you might
simply add my
new Heaven's
Song to them,
might you not?

entries.jp: 我が直々に力を貸して\nやるというのだ\n悪い話ではあるまい？
entries.en:
I am offering you
my aid personally.
Hardly a bad
proposal, is it?

entries.jp: 強情な男よ\nだが　我はお前の\nそこを買っておる
entries.en:
A stubborn
man. But that
is exactly what
I value in you.

entries.jp: だからこそ　新選組という\n大所帯を纏めることの\nできる男なのだとな
entries.en:
It is precisely
why you are the
man who can
hold together a
company as
large as the
Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: 幕府の大老　井伊様に\nそこまでお褒めいただき\n感無量でございます
entries.en:
To be praised so
highly by the
shogunate's Great
Elder, Ii-sama... I
am deeply moved.

entries.jp: 我はお前のことを\nよく　よく　知っておる\nだからこそ後ろ盾もしよう
entries.en:
I know you very,
very well. That is
why I am willing
to be your patron.

entries.jp: しかし　悲しいかな\n幕臣の主な者達は\nお前を知らぬのだ
entries.en:
But sadly, the
chief retainers
of the shogunate
do not know you
at all.

entries.jp: ……人気のある者だけ残し\n新選組を解散させよと\n言う者までいる
entries.en:
...Some even say
the Shinsengumi
should be
disbanded,
keeping only the
popular ones.

entries.jp: どうか\nどうか　それだけは……
entries.en: Please... I beg\nyou, anything\nbut that...

entries.jp: 隊士達は\n私の大事な友であり\n家族なのです
entries.en:
The troopers
are my dear
friends... They
are my family.

entries.jp: お前の気持ちはよくわかる\n仲間思いの良い局長と\n我も知っておる
entries.en:
I understand your
feelings well. I
know you to be a
good commander
who cares for his
comrades.

entries.jp: しかし　結果が出なければ\n幕府にとって新選組など\n何の意味も無い
entries.en:
But without
results, the
Shinsengumi
means nothing to
the shogunate.

entries.jp: 井伊の意味有りげな\n微笑みに\n近藤は膝を突く
entries.en: At Ii's meaningful\nsmile, Kondo\nsank to his knees.

entries.jp: なにとぞ\nそれだけは……
entries.en: I beg of you...\nanything but\nthat...

entries.jp: 井伊は地にひれ伏す\n近藤の頭を扇で撫で\nそして首をなぞる
entries.en:
With his fan, Ii
stroked the head
of the prostrate
Kondo, then
traced it along
his neck.

entries.jp: ならば　春の大舞台\nその後の新選組雷舞……\n皆の前で腹を切れ
entries.en:
Then at the
Shinsengumi live
after the spring
audition... cut
open your belly
before them all.

entries.jp: ……なっ
隊士は泣き京中の噂となり\n離れていた者どもも\nお前を憐れみ戻るだろう
entries.en:
The troopers will
weep, all Kyoto
will talk, and
those who drifted
away will pity
you and return.

entries.jp: それが嫌なのであれば\n次の雷舞までに\n民の人気を戻せばいい
entries.en:
If that does not
suit you, simply
win back the
people's favor
by the next live.

entries.jp: まあ良い\nまずは今宵の雷舞を\n楽しみにしておるぞ
entries.en:
Well, no matter.
For now, I look
forward to
tonight's live.

entries.jp: ……くっ
entries.en: ...Ngh.

entries.jp: ……そろそろ出て来い\n後をつけてきているのは\nわかっているぞ？
entries.en:
...You may come
out now. I know
you have been
following me.

entries.jp: あれ？　ばれてた？\n尾行とか　馴れないことは\nするもんじゃないね
entries.en:
Huh? You
noticed? Guess
I shouldn't try
stuff I'm not
used to, like
tailing people.

entries.jp: いや　なかなかであった\n……その殺気さえ上手く\n隠せていればの話だがな
entries.en:
No, it was rather
good... had you
only managed to
hide that killing
intent.

entries.jp: ……偉い人が供も\n連れずに歩いてちゃ\nだめだよ？
entries.en:
...An important
man like you
shouldn't walk
around without
an escort, you
know?

entries.jp: 京の街は物騒で\nそれこそ辻斬りとか\n多いんだからさ
entries.en:
Kyoto's streets
are dangerous.
There are lots of
street slashers
and stuff around.

entries.jp: それを取り締まるのが\n新選組の仕事だろう？
entries.en:
And is it not the
Shinsengumi's
job to deal with
them?

entries.jp: 怪しいヤツを\n取り締まるのも\n新選組の仕事だよ？
entries.en:
Dealing with
suspicious types
is the
Shinsengumi's job
too, you know?

entries.jp: 我に刃を向けるのが\nどういう意味なのか\nわかっているのか？
entries.en:
Do you
understand what
it means to turn
your blade on me?

entries.jp: さあ？　アンタのことは\n知らないし　わかる頃には\n首が飛んでるんでしょ？
entries.en:
Who knows? I
don't know who
you are, and by
the time I find
out, your head
will be rolling,
right?

entries.jp: ……面白い\n本当に近藤は\nいい隊士を育てている
entries.en: ...Amusing. Kondo\ntruly raises fine\ntroopers.

entries.jp: まだまだ　ガキだよ\n愛獲なんてチャラチャラの\n侍ごっこかと思ってたら
entries.en:
I'm still just a kid.
I figured this
idol thing was
flashy samurai
make-believe,
but...

entries.jp: 近藤さんてば\n命がけなんだもん\nすっごく　やな気分
entries.en:
Kondo-san's
betting his life
on it. It makes me
feel really rotten.

entries.jp: 断っておくけど\nアンタにじゃない\n自分にだよ
entries.en: Just so you know,\nit's not you I'm\nsick of. It's me.

entries.jp: ほう……？
ああそうだ\nまずはその着物\n脱いでくれる？
entries.en:
Oh, right. First,
would you
mind taking off
that kimono?

entries.jp: 物取りがやったように\n見せたいから\n汚したくないんだ
entries.en:
I want it to look
like a robbery,
so I'd rather
not get it dirty.

entries.jp: 嫌だと言ったら？
entries.en: And if I refuse?

entries.jp: 普通に斬るだけかな？\n財布は抜いて　鴨川に\n捨てさせて貰うけどっ
entries.en:
Then I'll just cut
you down the
normal way? I'll
still take your
wallet and dump
you in the Kamo
River, though!

entries.jp: なっ……
entries.en: Wha...!

entries.jp:
間合いは完璧だった
踏み込みも確実だった
刀を抜く暇など
与えなかったはずだ
entries.en:
His range was
perfect. His
step was sure.
He should have
left no time to
draw a sword.

entries.jp: やれやれ　新選組が\n物取りの真似か？
entries.en:
Dear me. The
Shinsengumi,
playing at
robbery?

entries.jp:
……しかし　目の前に
その男は無傷で立っていた
沖田をあざ笑うかのように
扇を広げ　涼しげに微笑んだ
entries.en:
...Yet the man
stood before him
unharmed. As if
mocking Okita,
he spread his fan
and smiled coolly.

entries.jp: ……なるほど鉄扇か\nその扇　骨に鉄を仕込んで\nあるんだね
entries.en:
...I see, an iron
fan. That fan
has iron hidden
in its ribs, huh.

entries.jp: ……仕込んであるのは\n鉄だけではないぞ？
entries.en: ...Iron is not\nall that is\nhidden in it.

entries.jp:
井伊が扇ぐ度
今まで沖田が　かいだことも
ないような不思議な香りが
広まっていく
entries.en:
With each wave
of Ii's fan, a
strange scent
unlike any
Okita had ever
smelled spread
through the air.

entries.jp: な……に……これ……\n頭がくらくらする
entries.en: Wh...at... is\nthis... My head's\nspinning...

entries.jp: 没薬に迷迭香を\n混ぜたものだ
entries.en: Myrrh, blended\nwith rosemary.

entries.jp: 我はよく狙われるのでな\n護身用だ
entries.en:
I am often
targeted, you
see. It is for
self-defense.

entries.jp: くっ　これぐらい……\n近藤さんの命に比べたら\nなんてことない
entries.en:
Ngh... This
much... is nothing
compared to
Kondo-san's life.

entries.jp: ほぉ……まだ　\n動けるのか
entries.en: Oh... You can\nstill move?

entries.jp: お前を……斬るっ
entries.en: I'll... cut\nyou down!

entries.jp: 斬れるものなら斬ってみろ\n奪えるものなら奪ってみろ
entries.en:
Cut me, if you
can. Take what
you would, if
you can.

entries.jp: 慶喜様への忠誠と\nお前の近藤への想い\nどちらが強いか
entries.en:
My loyalty to
Yoshinobu-sama,
or your devotion
to Kondo. Which
is the stronger?

entries.jp: もちろん\n僕に決まってるっ！
entries.en: Mine, obviously!

entries.jp: その言葉　万死に値する！
entries.en: Those words\nmerit a thousand\ndeaths!

entries.jp: しかし　毒を喰らい\nまだ我に刃向かうとは……\nその意気　惜しいものよ
entries.en:
Yet to take
poison and still
raise your blade
against me...
Such spirit is a
pity to waste.

entries.jp: 近藤さんのためなら\n僕は修羅の道を行く\n羅刹にだってなる
entries.en:
For Kondo-san, I'll
walk the path of
carnage. I'll even
become a demon.

entries.jp: 地獄だって……
entries.en: Even into hell...

entries.jp: 喜んで落ちるさ
entries.en: I'd gladly fall.

entries.jp: んぅ
entries.en: Hmn.

entries.jp: うっ　うわぁぁぁぁぁっ！
entries.en: Ugh...\nWaaaaaaagh!

entries.jp:
沖田が渾身の一撃で鉄扇を
折った　その瞬間……
二人の間から放たれた光に
打たれ　沖田が倒れる
entries.en:
The instant
Okita's all-out
blow snapped
the iron fan... a
light burst from
between them
and struck
Okita down.

entries.jp: うぁぁぁ……\n頭が……割れる\nな　なにが……ぐぅぅ……
entries.en:
Aaagh... My
head... it's
splitting...
Wh-what's...
nngh...

entries.jp: これは……
entries.en: What is this...

entries.jp:
吉田松陰から奪った
超魂の欠片のひとつが
懐で反応していることに
井伊は驚いていた
entries.en:
To his surprise, Ii
felt one of the
Ultra Soul
fragments he had
taken from Shoin
Yoshida reacting
in his robes.

entries.jp:
砕けて空に散っていった
超魂の欠片が二度と
ひとつにならないように
手に入れた片魂をずっと
手元で封印していたのだ
entries.en:
He kept every
Piece Soul he took
sealed at his side,
so the Ultra Soul's
shards, scattered
across the sky,
could never be
one again.

entries.jp: なんと\n封印し呪詛で包んだ\n片魂が反応するとは
entries.en:
Remarkable... A
Piece Soul, sealed
and wrapped in
curses, reacting...

entries.jp: 今まで　これが反応する\nことはなかった
entries.en: Never once has it\nreacted until now.

entries.jp: こやつは片魂を宿せる\n器だったのか……
entries.en:
So this one is
a vessel able
to house a
Piece Soul...

entries.jp: 消すには惜しい命……\nでは　存分に使ってやろう\nふふふふ
entries.en:
A life too
precious to snuff
out... Then I shall
put it to full use.
Hehehehe.

entries.jp: うう……アイツを……\n斬らなければ……\n近藤……さん……が……
entries.en:
Ugh... I have to...
cut him down...
or else Kondo...
san... will...

entries.jp: お主　近藤を助けたくは\nないか？
entries.en: Tell me, boy. Do\nyou not wish to\nsave Kondo?

entries.jp: い　今さら……\nどういう……こと？
entries.en: Wh-what... do you\nmean... now...?

entries.jp: ……見目麗しく\n玲瓏と囀る雛鳥よ\nこれを授けてやろう
entries.en:
...O fair little
fledgling who
sings so
crystal clear,
I shall bestow
this upon you.

entries.jp:
井伊の懐から
くすんだ光が飛び出し
沖田の鼻先でふわりと
止まる
entries.en:
A dull light flew
from Ii's robes
and stopped,
floating, right
before Okita's
nose.

entries.jp: ……うっ\n頭が……ぐううっ……\nうあ……がぁぁぁ……
entries.en: ...Ugh... My\nhead... Ngggh...\nUah... Gaaah...

entries.jp: くすんだ光の明滅に合わせ\n沖田の足元がぐらぐらと揺れ\n頭は割れるように痛む
entries.en:
As the dull light
flickered, the
ground swayed
beneath Okita's
feet and his
head throbbed
as if splitting.

entries.jp: 潔さも小賢しさも併せ持ち\n清濁を共に抱く\n玲瓏の雛鳥よ
entries.en:
Both noble
and cunning,
embracing the
pure and the
foul alike, O
crystal-voiced
fledgling...

entries.jp: 呪魂（ダークソウル）を\n受け容れ　お前の身体を\n我に捧げよ
entries.en:
Accept the
Dark Soul, and
offer your
body up to me.

entries.jp: ううっ……\n誰が……
entries.en: Ugh... Like I\never would...

entries.jp: 拒めば拒むほど\n苦しくなるぞ？\n片魂はお前を欲している
entries.en:
The more you
resist, the more
it will hurt, you
know. The Piece
Soul desires you.

entries.jp: 井伊の言葉に呼応するように\n光は瞬き　沖田の周りを\nクルクルと回る
entries.en:
As if answering
Ii's words, the
light flickered
and circled round
and round Okita.

entries.jp: い　嫌だ……\n助けて……\n土方さん　近藤さん……
entries.en: N-no... Help me...\nHijikata-san...\nKondo-san...

entries.jp: その近藤も土方も新選組も\nお前が望むのならば\nすべて生かすことが出来る
entries.en:
Kondo, Hijikata,
the Shinsengumi...
If you so wish, I
can let every one
of them live.

entries.jp: ……本当に？
entries.en: ...Really?

entries.jp: ああ……本当だ\nお前は歌えばいい\nお前の望むまま歌えばいい
entries.en:
Yes... Truly. All
you need do is
sing. Sing as your
heart desires.

entries.jp: 霞む意識の中\n沖田の腕が光を掴む
entries.en:
His consciousness
fading, Okita
reached out and
grasped the light.

entries.jp:
光は一瞬逃げるように
身じろいだ後
沖田の身体に雪のように
溶けていった
entries.en:
The light shrank
back an instant,
as if to flee,
then melted into
Okita's body like
snow.

entries.jp:
近藤が引退を発表したのは
沖田が最後にして
最大の遅刻をした
ある夕闇の雷舞のこと
entries.en:
Kondo announced
his retirement at
a twilight live,
the day of Okita's
last and greatest
lateness.

entries.jp:
『自分が表に出るよりも
もっと隊士達を育てたい』
近藤の引退公演は
沢山の集客を生み
entries.en:
'Rather than
stand out front,
I want to train
the troopers.'
Kondo's farewell
show drew huge
crowds,

entries.jp: そこで　大々的に後釜に\n推された沖田は\n新選組一の人気者となる
entries.en:
and there Okita,
hailed as his
successor, became
the Shinsengumi's
most popular
member.

entries.jp: ……近藤さんは\n僕が守ります
entries.en: ...I'll protect\nKondo-san.

entries.jp: この命にかけても……\nこの心が闇に呑まれても
entries.en:
Even if it costs
my life... Even
if darkness
swallows my
heart.

entries.jp: な～んて　なにを\nやっているんだろう\n柄じゃないよね
entries.en:
Wow, listen to
me~ What am I
even doing? So
not my style.

entries.jp: そう思わない？\nそこに居る\n……クズ達もさ
entries.en:
Don't you
think so? ...You
scum hiding
over there?

entries.jp: ほう……\nクズとは随分な\n言いようだな
entries.en: Well, well...\n"Scum" is quite a\nthing to call us.

entries.jp: 近藤さんが亡くなった\nとたん　恩を忘れて
entries.en:
The moment
Kondo-san died,
you forgot
everything you
owed him

entries.jp: 井伊の走狗に成り下がった\n元隊士を　クズ以外に\nなんて呼べばいいの？
entries.en:
and sank to being
Ii's lapdogs. What
else would I call
ex-troopers like
that but scum?

entries.jp: 我々は　幕府直属の愛獲\nとして正しい道を選んだ\nただ　それだけだ
entries.en:
As idols serving
the shogunate
directly, we
chose the right
path. That's all.

entries.jp: ……で　何の用？
entries.en: ...So what do\nyou want?

entries.jp: 井伊様が　お前に\n戻ってこいと仰せだ
entries.en: Ii-sama orders\nyou to come back.

entries.jp: 今までの裏切り行為も\n許し新選組も復活させて\n下さるとも約束された
entries.en:
He has promised
to forgive your
betrayals and
even restore the
Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: 裏切り行為ってなんの事？\n意味わかんないんだけど
entries.en:
Betrayals? What
are you talking
about? You're not
making any sense.

entries.jp: とぼけるな\n井伊様に反逆し\n坂本を助けるような行動だ
entries.en:
Don't play dumb.
Defying Ii-sama,
going around
helping Sakamoto.

entries.jp: まあまあ……落ち着け\n沖田　新選組一賢い\nお前ならわかるだろう？
entries.en:
Now, now... Calm
down. Okita, the
smartest in the
Shinsengumi,
surely you
understand?

entries.jp: 幕府御用達愛獲が一夜で\nお尋ね者だ……我々が\nどんな思いだったかを
entries.en:
The shogunate's
official idols
turned wanted
men overnight...
You know how
that felt.

entries.jp: ごめん\nさっぱり　わからないよ
entries.en: Sorry. I don't\nhave a clue.

entries.jp: 今まで　俺たちは新選組に\n誠心誠意　尽くしてきた\nなのに近藤は裏切った
entries.en:
We gave the
Shinsengumi
our all, heart
and soul. And
yet Kondo
betrayed us.

entries.jp: 恩を仇で返すとは近藤の\n事だ　井伊様はあんなに\n良くして下さったのに……
entries.en:
Repaying
kindness with
treachery, that's
Kondo for you.
After all Ii-sama
did for him...

entries.jp: ……なに　それ\n本気で言ってる？
entries.en:
...What's that
supposed to
mean? You
serious?

entries.jp: 斬るよ？
entries.en: I'll cut you,\nyou know?

entries.jp: おお　怖い……\n綺麗な顔が台無しだぞ
entries.en:
Ooh, scary...
You're ruining
that pretty
face of yours.

entries.jp: なあ……もう我慢出来ない\nコイツ……殺そうぜ
entries.en: Hey... I can't\nstand it anymore.\nLet's kill this guy.

entries.jp: クズの腕で　僕をどうにか\n出来るわけないじゃない？\nバカなの？
entries.en:
As if scum like
you could lay a
finger on me.
Are you stupid?

entries.jp: ……クズ？\n今の俺たちは\n昔の俺たちじゃない
entries.en: ...Scum? We're\nnot who we\nused to be.

entries.jp: 月明かりの中\n隊士達の影がゆらりと\n大きく膨らむ
entries.en:
In the moonlight,
the troopers'
shadows wavered
and swelled.

entries.jp: お前に　負け続けた\n隊士時代の俺たちじゃ\nないんだ
entries.en:
We're not the
troopers who
kept losing to
you anymore.

entries.jp: その姿……まさか……
entries.en: That form...\nNo way...

entries.jp:
二人の顔がみるみる歪み
身体はねじくれ
四肢は地を這い
獣のような臭いが漂う
entries.en:
The two men's
faces warped,
their bodies
twisted, their
limbs crawled on
the ground, and
a beastly stench
filled the air.

entries.jp: 我々は　井伊様から\n特別な力を頂いたのだ
entries.en: Ii-sama has\ngranted us a\nspecial power.

entries.jp:
陰口を叩かれたこともある
喧嘩をふっかけられたことも
一度や二度ではない
しかし　それも上を目指すが
故のこと……
entries.en:
We were
badmouthed. Had
fights picked with
us, more than
once or twice. But
only because we
aimed higher...

entries.jp: 近藤さんと一緒に歌いたい\n近藤さんに認められたい\n新選組として舞台に立ちたい
entries.en:
We want to sing
with Kondo-san.
We want
Kondo-san to
recognize us.
We want to take
the stage as the
Shinsengumi.

entries.jp: 彼らは隊士として\n同じ釜の飯を食い　共に\n切磋琢磨した仲間だった
entries.en:
As troopers,
they had eaten
from the same
pot and pushed
one another to
improve. They
had been
comrades.

entries.jp: 僕への嫉妬　近藤さんを\n失った悲しみ……それを\n井伊に歪められたんだね
entries.en:
Jealousy of me,
grief at losing
Kondo-san... Ii
twisted all
that, didn't he?

entries.jp: 沖田の頬を涙が伝う
entries.en: Tears ran down\nOkita's cheeks.

entries.jp:
彼らは　井伊の元に
走ったのではない
ただ　少しだけ
他の隊士より闇が深かった
それを利用されて
しまったのだ
entries.en:
They had not
run to Ii. Their
darkness was
just a little
deeper than the
other troopers',
and it was used
against them.

entries.jp: 僕と同じだね
entries.en: Just like me.

entries.jp: 僕の歌で\n今　楽にしてあげるよ
entries.en: With my song, I'll\nput you out of\nyour pain now.

entries.jp: 心に届くはず\nいいや　必ず届かせるよ
entries.en: It'll reach your\nhearts. No... I'll\nmake sure it does.

entries.jp: 僕の歌が　君達を\n解放する……！
entries.en: My song will\nset you free...!
